A
Austin PooleGoogle review
★★★★★

We recently bought a new home with large/custom windows. Our builder recommended Howard’s Draperies so we gave him a call. Howard is a true pro and helped us first time home owners navigate what is, surprisingly, a dizzying array of choices (blackout drapes, different colors, mounting location of the hardware, etc.). Howard actually came out to measure our windows the day before he went on vacation; despite this, we received amazing blinds in a timely fashion. His installer, John, also clearly has a lot of experience and gets things up quickly and looking great. Howard and John are a great team and we were very pleased with the entire process and highly recommend Howard’s Draperies.
